provenance.pipeline: satsuki v1 (v1.0.1 editorial re-edit: usage-note reshaping corpus-wide, lane discrimination for same-surface families, against prompts/style.md)

patterns.usage_note: Names the purpose of a trip: the slot takes a noun of activity (買い物に, 散歩に) or a verb's masu-stem (見に, 迎えに), and the main clause is a verb of movement, 行く, 来る, 帰る, 出かける. Sibling lanes take the destination itself (東京に戻る), the person told something (親に言う), and the point where something simply is (駅の裏にある). An object goes before the masu-stem, never after the pattern (雑誌を買いに行く).

examples.ruby: 今日[きょう]は昼[ひる]から友達[ともだち]と映画[えいが]を見[み]に行[い]く。
examples.english: This afternoon I'm going to see a movie with a friend.

examples.ruby: 母[はは]が空港[くうこう]まで迎[むか]えに来[き]てくれた。
examples.english: My mother came all the way to the airport to pick me up.

examples.ruby: スーパーは近[ちか]いから、車[くるま]で買[か]い物[もの]にゃ行[い]かないよ。
examples.english: The supermarket's close by, so it's not like I drive out to do the shopping.
